title: Borborigmos
author: Surinameri
changes: Human tummy rumble (borborygmus) after 12 hours without food. Trimmed to 15.85–18.45 s of the original, mixed to mono, gentle 12 dB/oct high-pass at 70 Hz, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
